title: ensure_provider_runtime installs stale hydrate without CAS; no single-flight (keychain prompt storm)
notes: Partially fixed — remaining part per 2026-09-29 re-check: db5b8c34 added a single-flight gate (hydrate_gate, dive/src-tauri/src/ipc/state.rs:119,323) and swap_runtime_if_none (:239-250, used at :366). Stale hydrates can no longer clobber a connect or select. Remaining: the CAS only checks runtime.kind.is_none(), and provider_disconnect_impl (ipc/provider.rs:548-574) swaps to none only if its config_id is active, which it never is during a hydrate because a hydrate runs only when the runtime is none. A hydrate that read a provider's key before a concurrent disconnect deleted it still passes the CAS and installs the disconnected provider in memory.
repro: With the runtime at none and hydrate blocked in the keyring read of provider X, call provider_disconnect(X); when the hydrate completes, the runtime is X
